items.title: Together in 2027 Winter Mitten Badge
items.alt: Three smiling navy, red and cream mittens rise above a Together in 2027 badge trimmed with evergreen and gold ornaments.
items.description: Snowflake and geometric patterns decorate the raised mittens, while striped ribbon curls around the round gold-edged badge.

items.title: Welcome 2027 Family Celebration
items.alt: Two adults hold a red Welcome banner behind two children carrying gold 2027 numerals.
items.description: A blue-sweatered adult and a red-skirted adult frame the smiling children, whose blue outfit and dotted red dress echo the banner’s bright colors.

items.title: Our 2027 Couple Toast
items.alt: A smiling cartoon couple raises clear drinks behind a red heart sign reading Our 2027.
items.description: The woman’s red dress and the man’s navy jacket frame a gold-edged heart decorated with small hearts and a wide red ribbon.

items.title: 2027 I’ve Got This Thumbs-Up Lettering
items.alt: Orange 2027 I’ve Got This lettering is flanked by two white cartoon thumbs-up gloves beneath a navy star.
items.description: Heavy rounded letters and dark outlines create a bold compact sticker shape with the year above the two-line message.

items.title: 2027 Looks Good on Me Sunshine
items.alt: A smiling sun in blue sunglasses points outward beneath navy 2027 numerals and above coral Looks Good on Me lettering.
items.description: A yellow star and a coral star balance the lively sun character, whose raised hands extend into the open sides of the phrase.

items.title: Hello New Possibilities 2027 Key Plaque
items.alt: A gold key with a teal star bow leans beside a teal plaque reading Hello New Possibilities 2027.
items.description: Gold scrollwork frames the raised cream message, while the star-shaped key head and small rays extend beyond the plaque.
